name: Return to the Crossroads.
label: Quest
description: Gryshka's reply is on its way from Orgrimmar to Zargh at the Crossroads. A wind rider carries it across the distance between Durotar and the Barrens.

clips.title: The story
paras: Gryshka's reply is on its way from Orgrimmar to Zargh at the Crossroads. A wind rider carries it across the distance between Durotar and the Barrens.

You carry Gryshka's written reply to Zargh after bringing her a parcel of prime meat in Orgrimmar. Doras, the wind rider master atop Orgrimmar's high bluffs, provides a mount for the return to the Barrens. You have already met Devrak at the Crossroads, so the wyverns know the flight path. The ride crosses the desert sky and saves you the long march overland across the Southfury River.

Zargh's courtship has won Gryshka's warm reply. Quality provisions have pleased her, and Zargh celebrates, even musing about an impending wedding. The delivery also brings you back to the Barrens' central hub for travel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My wind riders are trained to fly to many different places, as long as you have already been to that place and spoken with the wind rider master there.
You have been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master Devrak, so now you can fly directly to him from here. Once you're at the Crossroads, you can deliver Gryshka's letter to Zargh.
Speak with me when you are ready to go.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you returned from Orgrimmar? Did Gryshka like the meat I sent her?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hah! I guess she liked it! Nothing brings red to a lady's cheeks like a big, juicy steak!
Thank you, friend. You've done me a great service. Here is some money for your trouble, and don't be surprised if I invite you to my wedding!
